findingDetails.title: Guard drift/missing tests reuse the implementation's twin formula so the path assertions cannot catch a wrong authored twin
findingDetails.case: Authored tree diverges in generation; guard names a nonexistent twin and the test fixture shares the same formula so the suite stays green
findingDetails.evidence: guard.cjs:70 and test:591 use the identical path.join(authoredRoot, path.relative(runtimeRoot, runtimeManifest)); assertion at :598 checks the same computation
findingDetails.userImpact: The only tests for the new messages cannot fail when the named authored path diverges from the real authored layout
findingDetails.scopeProof: Only guard references are the manifest suite (require at :28) and typo-flags.test.cjs:106 (unknown option); no divergent-generation fixture exists
findingDetails.recommendation: Place the fixture at an independently determined location (layout-resolved or literal) and add one divergent-generation case
